master_prompts.base:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one completely NEW Jems Gem Pal character named BRIO, BASE form. A charming fantasy resonance-hopper inspired by the warmth, spring tension, plucked sound and sculpted curves of an acoustic guitar. This is a fresh species, with a memorable creature silhouette. One full-body character only. No text.
VISUAL IDEA: A compact squat seed-shaped fantasy hopper, somewhere between a tiny sprout and an appealing soft cricket, rendered with elegant simple shapes. It crouches low in an asymmetrical listening pose, ready to bounce, with a round pear-like abdomen and a smaller smooth cream wedge face at the front. Large expressive warm dark-brown eyes with white sclera, slightly intent eyelids, a tiny crooked pleased smile, two short gently curved velvety antennae. No nose muzzle, no mammalian floppy ears. Its body is rich muted cinnamon/mahogany with a soft warm cream face and underbody; clean smooth matte sculpted texture, not hairy or realistic insect anatomy.
ANATOMY: Exactly SIX limbs, clearly rooted and logically arranged: TWO chunky folded hind jumping legs with high rounded thighs and low curved feet; TWO small middle support legs; TWO small forward feet near the face. These are compact creature limbs, without human fingers or human arm proportions. Choose a three-quarter view that makes the paired limb arrangement easy to understand, with clear silhouettes rather than a tangle. Large hind legs create a distinctive springy crouch. Small forefeet ground the character. One hind heel lifted slightly as it listens.
PURPOSEFUL GEM ANATOMY: Exactly TWO large radiant HONEY-GOLD / AMBER crystal wing cases lie folded over the abdomen, shaped like broad thick guitar picks. They are its anatomical sounding plates, not a backpack or ornament. Together they form a striking folded teardrop carapace; one plate slightly overlaps the other at a clear seam. Each plate is a large solid cut gemstone with strong angular facets, luminous transparent golden depth, a little warm orange at its root and pale champagne highlights. They are unmistakably gemstones, not translucent insect wings, metallic armor or shiny skin. The two rounded roots attach directly to the upper thorax with compact pale mineral collars, visibly connected to the body. The plates must be beautiful and dominant in the silhouette, approximately half the body length, with crisp faceting distinct from the soft dark russet skin. A smooth curved ridge on one folded hind leg reaches just under a plate edge, suggesting it can pluck the plate like a resonating string. No visible wire or literal guitar.
PERSONALITY: Alert and quietly cheeky, full of pent-up rhythm, listening to its own little note. Cute and unusual rather than infantile. Strong collectible-character appeal and tasteful asymmetry in pose.
STYLE: Polished Jems tactile storybook 3D character concept, warm cinematic studio light, soft matte body, sharply cut translucent crystal reflections, high-end shapes, clean detail. The supplied Jems board is a material/finish reference only: do not copy those species, their faces exactly, limbs, colors or composition. The guitar photo is inspiration only; don't reproduce the object or room.
COMPOSITION: One full-body character, three-quarter view from slightly above at roughly face height, centered with comfortable margins on pale warm ivory background with minimal contact shadow. Base should occupy a low compact triangular silhouette. No scenery, props, musical notes, labels, logos, glow clutter, human hands, humanoid torso, scythe arms, giant moustache, extra wings, or accessory instrument.
master_prompts.mature:
Use case: stylized-concept. Develop the supplied BRIO Base image into its GROWN form. This is exactly the second of two forms. One complete grown character only; no text, no Base inset.
Preserve exact species identity: cinnamon-mahogany matte sculpted body; warm cream underside and cream wedge face with the little pointed russet forehead; lively large brown eyes, two gently curved short antennae, curved cream accent lines, pale mineral gem roots, brilliant honey-gold amber crystal material. Six legs. Friendly clever personality. Keep the finish soft and sculpted, not realistic insects, fur, polished wood or mechanical robot parts.
BIG STRUCTURAL TRANSFORMATION: The compact crouched seed body has developed into an athletic long-bodied resonance hopper. Its forward thorax is raised, with a small proud head; the abdomen is tapered and gracefully recurved upward behind it, made of three broad smooth joined lobes rather than realistic insect plates. Two large hind jumping legs are now strongly articulated, following elegant long zigzag curves with powerful rounded thighs and grounded spring feet. The other four smaller legs form two distinct pairs of support/plucking feet along the underside. Show all six endpoints clearly in a poised low leaping stance; no human arms or hands. It must still be a creature on six legs, not standing upright like a person. Head smaller relative to torso than Base. The silhouette should read as a different capable life stage even at the same displayed height.
GEM DEVELOPMENT: The two solid amber pick-shaped plates on Base have developed into TWO spectacular long SWEPT RESONANCE FINS rooted directly at paired mineral joints on the thorax. Each fin is shaped like a single asymmetric curved leaf/plectrum that has stretched backward and opened into a crescent: a broad thick outer edge of sharply faceted transparent honey-amber gemstone supports an inner panel of delicate taut warm-gold translucent membrane. Keep the faceted gem edges substantial and dominant; a beautiful solid crystalline leading edge and thick angular faceted tip, with a translucent inner acoustic panel, not feathered or fairy wings. Show both fins, unfolded at distinct angles into an open rearward V, one slightly behind the other, so their roots and whole shape remain readable. No extra wings, gem combs, horns, crystal jewelry, or random spikes. These are its actual anatomical sound structures, not a carried instrument. Their greater tension and wider spread let it sustain a rolling musical rhythm rather than one short chirp.
POSE: One middle leg touches the lower rim of the nearer sounding fin, with its elbow/root visibly connected and other support feet stable. The powerful hind legs stand ready to spring. Expression intent and cheeky, one eyebrow slightly raised, like it has found a surprisingly good beat. Keep body and fin negative spaces clean and individual limbs traceable. Avoid letting lifted fins hide the head or make the character humanoid.
COMPOSITION: Solo full-body Grown Brio, facing right in the same three-quarter direction as Base, centered at similar displayed height with clear margins, warm ivory background and a soft ground shadow. Polished tactile Jems storybook 3D concept art, soft body contrasted with crisp glassy jewel facets, warm light with restrained shadows. Complete antennae, fin tips and feet in frame. No props, literal guitar, wires, text, musical notes, effects, or second character.
master_prompts.mature_anatomy_repair:
Precise local anatomy correction to the supplied GROWN BRIO image. Preserve the exact character, face, eyes, antennae, colors, material, crystal fins, two fin roots, tapered upward abdomen, overall pose, framing, lighting and background.
FIX ONLY THE LIMBS: Remove the entire extra RAISED ARM AND HAND that currently reaches upward to hold the underside of the nearer golden fin (the pale fingertips and brown upright appendage at the center-left of the picture). This extra limb must disappear completely. The fin remains attached at its existing mineral root and does not need a hand. Do not turn the hand into a gem or another prop.
There must be EXACTLY SIX LEGS with SIX FEET on the ground: TWO large folded hind jumping legs at the left, TWO smaller middle walking legs, TWO forelegs near the head at the right. At the center of the image, redraw the near middle walking leg as ONE simple continuous bent leg: a clearly visible joint attached to the underside of the thorax, then one elbow-like bend, then its existing pale three-toed foot resting on the floor. Remove any branch extending upward from this middle leg. Every one of the six legs must have one root on the body and one endpoint on the floor; no forked limbs. Keep the other five ground legs as close to the reference as possible.
One character only, zero hands holding wings, no extra legs, no added details or text. The result should be the exact same grown Brio artwork with the surplus raised arm removed and that one middle leg attachment made anatomically coherent.
